title: Implement authorized connections between organizations
description:
Gherkin already exists in features/authorized_connections.feature (4 @wip scenarios) with StepNotImplementedError in authorized_connections_steps.py. Spec landed in PR 182.

Implement the product: a connection is a clip (borrowed standing on a named channel, never the computer). Four scenarios must pass and drop @wip:
1. Propose within ceiling -> authorized and clipped
2. Propose outside ceiling -> refused
3. Exceed requester ceiling -> escalate to nearest covering member
4. Exceed every member ceiling -> stay blocked

Reuse ceiling/escalation/org channel setup already in steps. Gherkin-first (scenarios exist). Dual path not applicable (Python control plane). PR to develop. Do not touch web/ Footer or da7f95 brand work.
